description: Custom Filter by Dunboxed: A Smarter Way to Slice Data in Power BI The Custom Filter visual is a powerful, flexible filtering component built for Power BI reports. It provides users with two intuitive ways to filter data: Checklist of values (checkbox-based) Manual input field for keywords or comma-separated lists These two modes List and Input are fully synchronized to ensure a seamless filtering experience: Selecting multiple values using checkboxes updates the input field automatically. Typing or pasting into the input updates the checkboxes instantly. This makes it easy to apply filters without the limitations of the default Power BI slicer. Whether you're selecting one item or pasting a long list, the Custom Filter handles it smoothly saving time and effort, especially with large datasets. This visual makes it easy to apply filters without the limitations of the default Power BI slicer. Whether you're selecting one item or pasting in a long list of values, the custom filter handles it smoothly, saving time and effort—especially for large datasets. In addition to selecting values, the visual offers an Include/Exclude toggle. This feature allows users to decide whether the filtered values should match (include mode) or be excluded (exclude mode) from the result set. This level of control adds flexibility for deeper analytical scenarios and supports more complex filtering…
